verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a web prototype for evaluating first-semester engineering students at Universidad del Valle Sede Tuluá. The focus is on providing a tool for monitoring directives to generate more efficient projects or strategies that mitigate student dropout in the academic program. The project utilizes the agile Kanban methodology, suggesting an e-learning context. The evaluation of variables such as Motivation and Communication Interpersonal, along with Lógica Matemática (Mathematical Logic), further supports this classification.
